name: Vetluzhsky-Varnavino Gas Pipeline, Stage II (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)
monitor_reason: concrete step (leg c) and length (leg d): programme-level plan only, no confirmed design completion/permit/tender/contract for this line, construction slipped from 2027 to 'next stage' after 2027; 116 km figure is ambiguous (stage II alone vs Krasnye Baki-Varnavino total, 22 -> 116 km)
researcher_notes: No roster match (no Vetluzhsky/Varnavino/Krasnye Baki row; nearest Gorky-Cherepovets P2310, Kazan-Gorky P2322 are unrelated trunks). Intersettlement high-pressure distribution line in the northern Nizhny Novgorod gasification programme; sponsor Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod (regional programme with Nizhny Novgorod govt; no entity_lookup match, would be new entity). Sources: gipernn.ru 2023-12-20 (regional energy minister: Vetluzhsky-Varnavino 13 km first stage and 116 km second stage, part of >360 km northern network); nobl.ru (stage I, 13 km, to complete 2023; first stage built per consolidator); gipernn.ru 2024-12-12 (Krasnye Baki-Varnavino extended from 22 to 116 km to cover more settlements; design 2025-26, Vetluzhsky-Varnavino and Uren-Vetluga lines targeted 2027, programme investment raised to 26.3 bn rub); pravda-nn.ru 2026-09 (governor Nikitin: Shakhunya/Sharanga/Tonkino/Tonshaevo next year, 'next stage includes Vetluga and Varnavino', so Varnavino line is after 2027). Candidate evidence URL nn.mk.ru 2026-01 does not mention Vetluzhsky-Varnavino (lists Obkhod-Uren, Shakhunya, Tonshaevo, Tonkino, Sharanga); not cited. Fails add-threshold: no concrete step (design/FEED award, permit, tender) documented for stage II, and the length is ambiguous. Tier low. Re-check when design completion or construction tender appears. If later added: Status proposed, Owner Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod, 116 km (verify stage II alone), start Vetluzhsky (Krasnobakovsky), end Varnavino, no route.
